Easily a top 5 horrible gaming community ever. The game itself is also pretty mid (however still fun with friends) but its not as bad if you just avoid trying to interact with the community.

The reasons for the community being bad is a long list and one I don't care to list out in its entirety and why I think its bad so ill just simplify it. Firstly the vast majority of survivor only players cry constantly and think the game is killer sided (its not at all) They cry when you don't follow their made up rules like not tunneling or they cry when you simply play a certain killer and use their power. Secondly the community tries to cancel people (most recently TheBurntPeanut) for just playing the game and the devs giving them stuff free to promote the game. More than just those reason like the community being way to [strike]woke[/strike] but moving on to why the game itself is mid....

The devs mainly focus on making sure the survivor player base is taken care of and babysitting them while leaving the killers to rot basically. Most of the nerfs in patches go to killers and most of the buffs to survivors, to simplify. Its very obvious to anyone who plays both sides or to anyone who is good to see that survivors are the ones with the massive advantage. The games graphics also just not good at all but that is getting worked on but I have doubts it will look good even after the graphics update. The grind to unlock all tier 3 perks for all killers alone is WAY to long and will take you hundreds of hours maybe even over 1k, and that's not counting the grind to unlock them all on survivors as well. Then to add to the grind, unlocking all the original killers and survivors will take just as long. Mix in the fact that they are starting to lose the licenses for all the non original killers like Chucky, Myers, and Pinhead so you cant buy them anymore, and the fact that they will add killers, you buy them cause they are decent, then they nerf them. Lots of reasons to stay away from this game!

With all that said if you are planning on buying it just to play with friends (like me) its not the worse game. But the game as a game you play normally.... well AVOID

Dead by Daylight has an amazing concept, iconic horror characters, interesting killer abilities, and so much wasted potential.

Unfortunately, the experience for casual-beginers and returning players(after long time) can be absolutely miserable. You just want to enjoy a couple of matches after a long day, but instead you get matched against experienced players who know every map, every perk, and every trick in the book.

The gameplay also gets incredibly repetitive. Repair generators, run, hide, get hooked, repeat.

And here's my biggest complaint: WHY IS THERE STILL NO PROPER SINGLE-PLAYER MODE?

I would happily play hundreds of hours against AI survivors and AI killers with adjustable difficulty, from Easy to Nightmare, proper progression, Bloodpoints, Prestige, and unlockable perks.

I don't want to compete with strangers who spend their lives mastering every single mechanic. I want to enjoy the fantastic horror characters I've paid for, at my own pace.

Yes, custom matches with survivor bots exist. But without proper difficulty settings, progression, rewards, or AI killers, they're no substitute for a real single-player experience.

I want to win sometimes and not everytime play against professional flashlight enthusiasts and unbeatable killers.

Until then, uninstalling. Maybe I'll see you next Halloween.
